description: No extends on purpose. Renovate's defaults are what this repository wants, and config:recommended would switch on the dependency dashboard along with everything else it composes.

lockFileMaintenance is the one addition. Renovate's ordinary updates are driven by what Cargo.toml and package.json declare, and osvVulnerabilityAlerts is documented as direct-only, so no Renovate mechanism reached a purely transitive crate. Every advisory found in the 2026-08-30 audit sweep was against one: anyhow and rand via tauri, event-listener via keyring, the yanked wasm-bindgen family via reqwest. None is declared here, and none of the first 23 Renovate PRs on this repository touched a crate that was not declared, so the drift had no owner but a manual sweep.

It runs daily rather than on the weekly default, matching the cadence of every other update on this repository. It pairs with the deny-warnings ratchet in src-tauri/.cargo/audit.toml: a lock-maintenance PR that pulls in a crate carrying an unlisted advisory fails the audit job rather than merging quietly. Such a PR needs a decision - take the fix, pin the crate, or add an entry naming the upstream owner and why it cannot be fixed here - not a rubber stamp.
